title: Release objective
text: Deliver a local desktop and browser workflow that preserves explicit engineering state.

title: Packet lineage
text: Every response evaluation is bound to the exact outgoing packet and state version.

title: Authority boundary
text: Visible provider output is evidence and candidate material, never authoritative project state.

title: Event store
text: Use SQLite WAL with an append-only event journal.

title: Old browser transport
text: Use a public localhost HTTP port for browser transport.

title: Current browser transport
text: Use Chrome Native Messaging and a user-only Unix socket.

title: Local-only data
text: Project transcript and state must remain on the device unless the user explicitly exports it.

title: Visible submission
text: Prompt context must remain visible and submission must require a current user action.

title: Cloud sync first
text: Do not make cloud synchronization a release prerequisite.
reconsideration_condition: A separately reviewed opt-in encrypted sync design is approved.

title: Hidden prompt channel
text: Do not inject project context through an invisible provider channel.
reconsideration_condition: The provider exposes an inspectable user-approved field.

title: Protocol freeze
text: Protocol schemas and cross-language digest fixtures are complete; next boundary is packaging.

title: Gateway purity checks
text: Gateway preview purity and restart determinism checks are complete; do not repeat implementation discovery.

title: Chromium unpacked check
text: Load the production extension bundle in Chromium and verify the pinned identity.

title: Unsigned app walkthrough
text: Run the unsigned macOS app and native-host installer from a clean checkout.

title: Transport inspection
text: Local inspection records the native messaging and Unix-socket boundary.

title: Build verification
text: Deterministic fixture checks record protocol and gateway build behavior.
Define the local release boundary.
The release boundary includes a desktop console, a browser companion, and a local service.
Keep project data on device.
The data path will use local storage and explicit export only.
Record the event store decision.
SQLite WAL is recorded as the event store choice.
Compare browser transport options.
A public local port has a broader exposure boundary than native messaging.
Reject the public port.
The transport decision now uses native messaging and a user-only socket.
Make prompt context inspectable.
The context block will be written into the visible composer before the draft.
Do not submit while I am absent.
Submission remains gated by a current user action and visible approval.
Capture the protocol milestone.
The protocol milestone is complete and recorded with shared digest fixtures.
What remains for Chromium?
The unpacked extension identity and native-host attachment still need a walkthrough.
Keep cloud sync out of the first release.
Cloud sync remains a rejected prerequisite with an explicit reconsideration condition.
Show authority on every state card.
State cards will show authority, status, binding, provenance, and supersession.
Add intervention review.
The desktop console will expose intervention evidence and resolution actions.
Preserve superseded decisions in audit.
Superseded objects remain visible and link to their replacement.
Prepare an export path.
Portable export will include events, canonical state, retention policy, and checksums.
State the next boundary.
The next boundary is a clean unsigned app and browser walkthrough.
